payload.title: Promote legal datum-trend action and risk evidence
payload.decision: Promote E003's legal feature representation, ridge datum-plus-trend action, and forest risk score into the candidate bank, while withholding deployment and submission status until full-training packaging and Kaggle parity pass.
payload.rationale: The action improved pooled RMSE from 15.9099 to 10.9280 on all five maps, retained a 4.6557 gain under contiguous spatial blocks, improved all tail metrics, passed controls, reproduced byte-for-byte, and was independently rescored from raw rows. Risk evidence also passed repeated and spatial gates.
payload.revisit_trigger: A feature-provenance defect, failed full-training/test-distribution audit, failed Kaggle parity, or contradictory leaderboard evidence.
